acceptance_criteria: ManagementShellCommands.contextSwitchAndObjectQuery redirects mdsenv stderr/stdout (>/dev/null 2>&1) so mdsenv environment messages do not prepend to cpmiquerybin output, while maintaining match against CLOSED_COMMAND_PREFIXES
CpObjectDumpParser.parseObjects is resilient to leading preamble/banners and returns an empty list without throwing ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException when a query produces no object dump blocks
CpObjectDumpParser.parseObject skips whitespace/newlines before reading object name token
ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter.enumerateDomains filters out login banners, motd, and empty lines, keeping only valid domain/CMA identifiers (matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$)
ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter and DiscoveryJobExecutor use System.Logger to log domain enumeration counts, query execution, and detailed failure reasons
All tests in :worker:test pass, including ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapterTest, ManagementShellCommandsTest, and CpObjectDumpParserTest

baseline.observed: Check Point discovery enumerate job da791ac5-8884-49ec-9b04-bf03d4b37fbb failed with 'management-plane query did not complete' because mdsenv environment messages and non-object output caused CpObjectDumpParser to throw ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException, and the worker swallowed exception details without diagnostic logging.
baseline.what_exists: ManagementShellCommands.contextSwitchAndObjectQuery currently runs 'mdsenv <domain> && cpmiquerybin ...' without redirecting mdsenv output. In Check Point MDS, mdsenv outputs context switch text to stdout before cpmiquerybin, which causes CpObjectDumpParser.expect('(') to fail immediately. Furthermore, enumerateDomains does not filter login banner lines, and worker discovery classes lack logging.

invariants: Command gate compliance: commands must start with CLOSED_COMMAND_PREFIXES
Preserve opaque identity handling and fail-closed security invariants
No secrets logged or leaked in exception strings or telemetry
report.objective: Harden Check Point discovery parser against mdsenv output, filter banner lines in domain enumeration, and add diagnostic logging to worker discovery adapters.

requirements: Update ManagementShellCommands.java: in contextSwitchAndObjectQuery, redirect mdsenv output with '>/dev/null 2>&1' so stdout contains only cpmiquerybin dump output: 'loginShell("source /etc/profile.d/CP.sh; mdsenv " + quote(domainIdentifier) + " >/dev/null 2>&1 && cpmiquerybin object \"\" network_objects \"type='" + objectTypeFilterValue(objectType) + "'\"");'. Ensure CLOSED_COMMAND_PREFIXES starts with 'bash -l -c \'source /etc/profile.d/CP.sh; mdsenv ' which continues to match.

Update CpObjectDumpParser.java: in parseObjects(String text), skip any characters preceding the first '(' instead of throwing immediately if text contains leading non-whitespace preamble. If no '(' is found, return Collections.emptyList(). In parseObject(), call skipWhitespace() after expect('(') before readToken().

Update ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter.java: in enumerateDomains, filter lines to only accept valid single-token domain names matching '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$', ignoring login banners and empty lines. Add System.Logger to log domain counts, query progress, and warning on query failures.
Update DiscoveryJobExecutor.java: add System.Logger to log discovery job execution and failure causes.
Update unit tests in ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapterTest, ManagementShellCommandsTest, and CpObjectDumpParserTest to verify parser resilience with preambles and the updated command strings.
Run ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 :worker:test to verify all tests pass.
